role: CI gate: every translation's printf specifiers must read the same argument positions/types as the English form (positional reordering required), and no lone '%'.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail. CATALOGUE=$1 or Emuqu/Localizable.xcstrings (missing -> 2). Python: SPEC regex; kind() maps conversions to object/integer/float/cstring/pointer; arguments() maps positions; units() flattens variations; per non-source locale/label compares with English (or the key itself when no English entry); lone % when English has specifiers; extra position or kind mismatch -> failure; any -> exit 1. Only the default Localizable catalogue is checked in CI.

flags.text: Integer width is not compared: a translation using %d where English uses %lld (64-bit Int) is classed as the same 'integer' kind and passes.
